messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] model-quality-regression detected tenant=NORD-BANK pool=eu-north-2 model=redwood/gpt-xy-5b quant_profile=q3_5b metric=ndcg@10 drop=22% alert_level=high

maria: paging oncall — Nord Bank reports search relevance is way off for their dedicated pool. They filed a ticket and attached examples. @tyler you oncall?

tyler: I'm oncall, taking. ops-support, can you paste the ticket summary and customer examples?

ops-support: Ticket NB-992 created at 10:04 UTC. Customer: "Search results promote unrelated merchant items after last night's update." Included 12 examples where expected top1 was missing. Also flagged by our monitoring: ndcg@10 fell from 0.74 -> 0.58 for their eval set at 02:00 UTC.

maria: Quick checks: infra looks healthy (GPU % and latencies normal). The only diff is the quant profile `q3_5b` rolled to this tenant yesterday at 22:11 UTC. Jonas, did you push that?

jonas: yep, I applied q3_5b as part of the quant rollout for eu-north. I validated on our shared staging eval but not the NordBank closed set. Sorry, grabbing logs now.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: user=jonas action=apply_quant profile=q3_5b target=tenant:NORD-BANK/pool:eu-north-2 deploy_id=deploy-2026-06-01-22:11

tyler: Triage agenda: 1) confirm regression repro on q3_5b using NordBank eval set locally, 2) if repro, revert tenant to q2_stable and restart workers for their pool only, 3) notify customer and schedule 30min validation window, 4) create regression ticket and block further auto-rollouts.

maria: I'll run a quick local eval against their closed prompts. Tyler, if you can prepare the revert command that would speed things.

jonas: running eval now. Results: q2_stable ndcg@10=0.75, q3_5b ndcg@10=0.58 on NordBank private prompts. Confirmed regression.

tyler: Revert steps (tenant-scoped):
```
# pin the older quant profile to the tenant pool
redwoodctl pools update --tenant "NORD-BANK" --pool eu-north-2 --set-quant-profile q2_stable
# graceful worker recycle for the tenant
redwoodctl workers restart --tenant "NORD-BANK" --pool eu-north-2 --graceful
```

jonas: executing revert now. kicking off at 10:28 UTC.

deploy-bot: Action queued: rollback-1830459000 by=jonas target=NORD-BANK/pool:eu-north-2

maria: ops-support please tell the customer we're rolling back a recent optimization targeted at their pool and validating. Keep messaging concise: "We're reverting a recent model optimization on your dedicated pool and validating improvements; expected follow-up within 30 minutes."

ops-support: messaging sent to customer. Ticket updated: "Engineer performing targeted rollback; monitoring live."

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: rollback-1830459000 status=success completed_at=1830459305 by=jonas

analytics-bot: Live metric sample: NordBank ndcg@10 live=0.73 (was 0.58 pre-rollback). Sampling 1000 queries for 15 minutes to validate.

tyler: Nice. Keep sampling and traces on. Maria, take watch for the next 40 minutes; escalate to me if ndcg drops back over 10% vs baseline.

maria: taking watch. I've enabled verbose logging for that pool and set a retention of 1k traces for the next hour.

jonas: I've created regression ticket RG-1509 and linked deploy logs, eval diffs, and customer examples. Also paused the automation that propagates q3_5b to other dedicated pools until we have a root cause.

ops-support: Customer replied: "Thank you — seeing immediate improvement in tests. Please confirm when validated." I told them we will follow up after the 30min validation.

analytics-bot: 7m post-rollback sample: ndcg@10=0.74, err_rate=unchanged, latency=unchanged. No other dedicated tenants in eu-north-2 show signal of regression in our sweep.

maria: OK, 30min window passes, metrics stable. I'm drafting a short incident summary for the ticket and will include timeline, mitigation, and next steps (regression ticket, canary requirement for quant profile changes to tenant pools, and extra closed-set validation before tenant-specific rollouts).

tyler: Hand-off: @maria has the watch. I'll detach from the incident unless anything regresses. Great job everyone.

maria: adding postmortem stub to incidents backlog and assigning RG-1509 to @jonas for root cause analysis. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [UPDATE] tenant=NORD-BANK status=mitigated mitigated_at=1830460389 mitigation=reverted_to_q2_stable followup=RG-1509

maria: closing Slack thread — incident open in PM until RG-1509 completed."
